A fundamental aspect of protection in operating systems is rights amplification. Rights amplification enables a more privileged protection domain to perform an operation on behalf of a less privileged protection domain in a controlled fashion without violating protection in the system. For each of the following operating systems, state (a) the protection domain that they support, (b) the mechanism for crossing protection domains, (c) how rights are represented, (d) how rights are amplified crossing domains, and (e) how the OS determines whether to allow the domain crossing.
Hydra
Multics
Pilot
